baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated كذب is predicated of الفؤاد and constrained by the object-clause ما رأى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing supplies an encountered percept, the inwardly kindled heart registers it, and negated falsehood asserts correspondence between encounter and inward apprehension.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood against truth supplies the denied distortion, making the heart's registration truth-concordant.
The heart as inner kindling supplies the intense inward receiver whose apprehension is being tested.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the encountered content against which inward fidelity is measured.

changed_reading.before: A bare denial that the heart lied.
changed_reading.after: A concordance claim: inward apprehension faithfully registers what sight or insight encountered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كذب can mark a charge that fails to prove true, while the seen reaches الفؤاد.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vision functions like a charge or trajectory that must reach its inward target; negation says the perceptual event did not abort between seeing and heart-level uptake.

activation_trace.role: A charge proves false by failing in execution; negation supplies successful completion as the perceptual mechanism.
A heart that can be struck or reached supplies the inward endpoint reached by the percept.
Eye-or-insight seeing supplies the perceptual trajectory that is carried through rather than abandoned.

changed_reading.before: The verse only evaluates whether an inward statement is true.
changed_reading.after: The verse also evaluates whether seeing completed its commission by reaching and holding in the heart.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The رأى inventory includes reflective judgment as well as ocular perception, and الفؤاد names an inward faculty.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can vindicate not merely sensory intake but the heart's considered judgment about the encounter, while leaving the sensory reading intact.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood supplies the failed relation to reality that is denied of the inward judgment.
Inner kindling makes the heart an engaged center of apprehension rather than a detached optical instrument.
Opinion and reflective judgment supply a cognitive reading of رأى that coexists with direct sight.

changed_reading.before: What matters is only accurate eyesight.
changed_reading.after: The inward judgment formed from the encounter is itself affirmed as non-false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The supplied split mapping for رأى includes the non-dominant ر و ي branch of relaying reports.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seen event can activate a report-bearing afterlife: the heart is a relay in which perception must not be falsified before it becomes transmissible.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood supplies the distortion that a faithful relay must exclude.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the intermediate receiver and carrier of the encounter.
The secondary mapped branch of relaying reports or poetry supplies transmission as a live, form-distant resonance of the seen.

changed_reading.before: Seeing ends as a private visual event.
changed_reading.after: Seeing seeds a report whose fidelity is guarded at the heart-stage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech, concealed impartation, inward apprehension, and seen content form a transmission chain. The focus locates non-falsification at the heart-stage, so it denies self-authored distortion as well as ordinary lying.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood against truth names the distortion excluded at the chain's inward checkpoint.
The heart as inner kindling supplies the receptive middle of the transmission chain.
Eye-or-insight seeing supplies the received content whose fidelity is preserved.
Articulated speech supplies the chain's outward endpoint and makes inward fidelity consequential for utterance.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies an origin outside ordinary self-generated speech and feeds the inward receiver.
Divine report or inspiration immediately before the focus specifies the communicated content entering the fidelity chain.

structural_cues: 53:3-4 places speech, denied desire-source, and revelation immediately before the approach sequence.
53:10 repeats communication to the servant directly before the focus's paired ما clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, hidden impartation, heart, and seeing; I supply the directional chain revelation -> inward uptake -> articulable report. A live alternative is that these are adjacent affirmations without a staged transmission model.

changed_reading.before: The heart is simply sincere about an isolated vision.
changed_reading.after: The heart is the non-distorting checkpoint in a received revelation-to-perception-to-speech chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material-flow reading emerges: concealed knowledge comes near and descends like a lowered bucket; the inward kindling receives it as quenching, while negated كذب says the supply does not vanish or fail expectation.

activation_trace.role: Milk that disappears instead of lasting supplies failed nourishment; negation makes the inward supply dependable.
The heart as inner kindling supplies the heat that the delivered perception can answer or cool.
The non-dominant mapped branch of quenching and freedom from thirst supplies receptive satiation as a resonance of seeing.
Secretly cast knowledge supplies the subtle content that moves through the material analogy.
Nearness supplies the closing distance required for delivery to the inward receiver.
The bucket in a well supplies a vessel-like image for conveyed replenishment.
Hanging down from above supplies the direction of delivery into the waiting inward depth.

structural_cues: 53:4 introduces concealed impartation; 53:8 then coordinates drawing near and hanging down before 53:11 names inward seeing.
The focus juxtaposes the heat-bearing فؤاد with a split رأى inventory that contains water-bearing and quenching branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden knowledge, nearness, downward suspension, inner heat, quenching, and failed nourishment; I supply a single delivery-flow arrow among them. The live alternative is that the water images are only cross-root lexical echoes and dominant visual seeing exhausts the clause.

changed_reading.before: The vision is information accurately registered.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the vision is also replenishment delivered into inner heat, arriving without the expected supply failing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel stress-tests the focus: adversarial dispute tries to make testimony oscillate, the scene is enveloped, and vision is bounded against both deviation and excess. Heart-insight and eyesight therefore operate as a calibrated cross-check, not an unbounded ecstatic claim.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true by being carried through supplies the tested-success frame for perception.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies one side of the cross-check.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the adversarial pressure applied to the perceptual testimony.
The split branch's wavering or undulation supplies oscillation as what dispute attempts to induce.
Repeated eye-or-insight seeing supplies recurrence rather than a single unsupported impression.
An enveloping cover supplies difficult perceptual conditions under which fidelity is maintained.
The eye's inclination or fatigue supplies the undershoot error explicitly negated in the sequel.
Ocular seeing supplies the external channel paired with the focus's inward heart.
Heart-insight supplies the internal channel, making the eye/heart relation an explicit branch-level cross-check.
Exceeding the limit supplies the overshoot error explicitly negated alongside deviation.

structural_cues: 53:12 directly turns the seen content into an object of dispute.
53:13 repeats seeing; 53:16 introduces enveloping conditions; 53:17 balances two negations around the eye, deviation and excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispute, wavering, cover, eye, heart-insight, deviation, and limit-crossing; I classify deviation as undershoot, excess as overshoot, and their balance as calibration. Alternatively, 53:17 may praise eyesight independently without defining the heart's verification in 53:11.

changed_reading.before: A private inward assurance is asserted once.
changed_reading.after: The assurance is recurrent, adversarially tested, and bounded against both perceptual drift and imaginative overreach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context differentiates two interiors rather than endorsing inward feeling wholesale: the fuad is constrained by an encounter, while the nafs can incline toward desire and conjecture. Truth here is inward correspondence to what was seen, not projection from what is wanted.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood against truth supplies the correspondence failure denied of the encounter-bound heart.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies an interior faculty whose intensity is disciplined by seeing.
Reflective judgment supplies the inward construal that must remain answerable to the encounter.
Doubt and imagining supply the conjectural substitute that can be followed without knowledge.
The soul's inclination supplies desire as an inward force capable of selecting its preferred appearance.
What lies within the self as mind and inward thought supplies the alternative interior vulnerable to desire.
Stable correspondence with reality against falsehood supplies the external constraint that conjecture cannot replace.

structural_cues: 53:23 coordinates following conjecture with what selves desire.
53:28 denies knowledge and states that conjecture avails nothing against truth.
In 53:11 the second ما-clause makes the seen content constrain the heart's act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart, self, desire, conjecture, and reality-correspondence; I infer a disciplined-fuad versus projective-nafs contrast. A live alternative is that the later critique concerns only opponents and should not classify inner faculties in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Because the heart is inward, the verse validates subjective conviction.
changed_reading.after: The verse validates only an inward apprehension constrained by encounter, sharply unlike desire-fed conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later action -> visibility -> full completion sequence activates the focus's charge branch: truth is not static sincerity but a trajectory that becomes manifest and reaches its due completion.

activation_trace.role: A charge failing or proving true supplies the eventive test that later completion can activate.
The struck or reached heart supplies the first completed arrival of the perceptual trajectory.
Seeing supplies manifestation at the focus and links it to the later making-visible sequence.
Work and acquired action supply the concrete trajectory that is subsequently exposed.
Future seeing makes a previously carried-out action visible, modeling truth as eventual manifestation.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the endpoint that confirms a trajectory did not fail.

structural_cues: 53:39 limits the person to what was pursued; 53:40 says that pursuit will be seen; 53:41 follows with full recompense.
The focus already places negated failure, inward arrival, and seeing in one compact construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, later visibility, and full completion; I project that sequence backward as an analogy for كذب's fulfilled-charge branch. The alternative is that the later sequence concerns accountability only and does not revise the earlier perceptual event.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a static property of an inward report.
changed_reading.after: Truth is also eventive: the perceptual charge reaches its inward endpoint and, like action later made visible, proves itself by completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The secondary ر و ي mapping becomes structurally productive without replacing ordinary رأى: concealed communication enters the heart, survives without falsification, becomes speech, and is later encountered as a renewing report.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood supplies the corruption excluded from the report as it passes through the heart.
Inner kindling supplies the receiving and retaining center of the relay.
The non-dominant mapped branch of relaying reports and poetry supplies the transmission resonance while dominant seeing remains live.
Speech supplies outward articulation as the relay's public form.
Secretly imparted knowledge supplies the report's received origin rather than an invented one.
Speech continually renewed as news or report supplies the downstream object at which hearers react.

structural_cues: 53:3-4 joins articulation to received communication before the focus.
53:59 later designates the discourse as حديث, closing a reception-to-report arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split رأى/ر و ي mapping plus speech, impartation, and report; I infer a relay through the heart. The live alternative is that the secondary mapping is only formal branch potential and the dominant seeing sense fully explains the focus.

changed_reading.before: The heart verifies a perception that remains private.
changed_reading.after: The heart preserves a perception for faithful relay into speech and report, without collapsing seeing into narration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the non-delay branch normally belongs to a fuller idiom than the focus displays; it remains anchored in the exact negated كذب, the inward heart, and seeing, but downstream prose should present it only as a temporal resonance, not as the clause's direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Negated كذب stands between the inwardly kindled heart and what was seen.

activation_trace.role: Not delaying to act supplies immediacy as a strange secondary force of the negated verb.
The heart as inner kindling supplies a receiver primed for immediate uptake.
Eye-or-insight seeing supplies the event the inward faculty takes up without lag.

changed_reading.before: The heart eventually assents without lying.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the heart does not lag or hesitate behind the seeing but ignites in immediate uptake.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-material reading is surprising because deceptive dyed cloth and the mirror are branch-distant from the syntax; it remains anchored in كذب, visible appearance under رأى, and inward appraisal, but should be rendered as an anti-appearance analogy rather than a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly relates possible falsification, an inward evaluator, and visible or intelligible appearance.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth whose appearance deceives supplies surface pattern as a possible counterfeit of reality.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the evaluator not captured by ornamental surface.
Visible appearance and mirror supply the presented surface whose fidelity is at issue.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely says a proposition about a vision is honest.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, the visible display does not behave like deceptive ornament: its appearance survives inward appraisal without counterfeiting itself.

strongest_changes: The context turned generic sincerity into fidelity at the heart-stage of a revelation-to-perception-to-speech chain.
The immediate sequel made the perception recurrent, contestable, and calibrated against covering, deviation, and excess.
Desire and conjecture prevented the truthful heart from being misread as an endorsement of subjective feeling.
The supplied split رأى mapping kept report-relay and descent/quenching models alive as contained coexisting activations.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held sensory concordance, reflective judgment, fulfilled perceptual action, faithful report relay, and material replenishment together without forcing a single winner; the strangest useful activation joined inner heat to quenching and a lowered delivery while remaining explicitly exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone leaves the heart's exact role open: perceiver, verifier, endpoint, or relay.
The secondary ر و ي mapping may be genuine latent activation or only formal cross-root resonance.
The fulfilled-charge, failed-supply, and non-delay branches of كذب remain more construction-distant than ordinary falsehood.
Several context mechanisms are abductive arrows across adjacent or later sequences, not directions stated by the packet.
